theme.text: Intimate self-discovery: frame the show as a reflective journey through identity and quiet rebellion, echoing the narrative depth of films like *Booksmart* and *Little Women*.
Mellow cinema soundtrack: pair Night Swim's sound with visuals or live narration inspired by indie film; appeal to fans of *Licorice Pizza* and *Guava Island*.

merch.text: Minimalist tote in organic cotton (brand affinity with Madewell, Everlane): understated, durable, reusable.
Limited-run risograph art print (brand affinity with Society6): handcrafted aesthetic, collectible, supports emerging design.
Matte enamel pin set (brand affinity with Ban.do): small, tactile, cult appeal; pairs with indie fashion sensibility.
